{{Quote|As I was saying, perhaps I could offer a diversion by catching up on old times&mdash;you know, some fancy culinary tidbits borrowed from a servant's tray, a flask of some Cedrellian aged wine, and thou, so to speak. Non-committal of course.|[[Wendell Wright-Sims]]|<ref name="An Old Flame in Need...">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''Cedrellian aged wine''' was a type of fine [[Wine/Legends|wine]] from the [[Cedrell system/Legends|Cedrell system]], favored by the upper class.

During a gala to commemorate the opening night of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], spice dealer [[Wendell Wright-Sims]] attempted to seduce his former lover, [[Mayli Weng]], by offering to provide this wine during their potential rendezvous.
